card.name: French 'samedi' and date digits
card.fires_on: Responds to 'amedi' in the French word 'samedi' (Saturday) before a date like '7 avril 2012'. It also fires weakly on the last digit of two-digit day numbers in dates.

modes.label: samedi in French dates
modes.description: The 'amedi' piece of 'samedi' right before a French-style date.

modes.label: Day-of-month digit
modes.description: The second digit of a two-digit day number after a month name.

card.plain: It spots the French word for Saturday in a date line, and weakly the final digit of a day number in dates.
